summary: tiktok is back and works the same way as instagram
changes: pick instagram or tiktok in the platform menu. a tiktok session searches your keywords, watches, likes, follows and comments within your targets, just like instagram.
tiktok gets everything instagram has: resume, the end-of-session summary, a different path through the results each session, and never commenting twice on the same post.
a tiktok like or follow only counts once a fresh copy of the post still shows it. if tiktok undoes it on your account, it shows as not confirmed instead.
sign in to tiktok in the same chrome profile and keep tiktok in english before starting.
instagram sessions work exactly as before.
replace the files in your original extension folder, reload the extension and reopen warm-up.
